;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Terrorism in Russia]]
**A [[Police of Russia|police]] officer is wounded after being stabbed several times by a 16-year-old boy in [[Kukmor]], [[Tatarstan]], [[Russia]]. The attacker is then shot dead by a fellow officer. The stabbing is being investigated as a [[terrorist]] incident. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/10/30/russian-police-kill-teenager-who-stabbed-officer-in-tatarstan (Al Jazeera)]

;Arts and culture
*[[List of most expensive coins]]
**A near-mint condition [[Roman currency|Roman coin]] celebrating [[Assassination of Julius Caesar|the assassination]] of [[Roman dictator|dictator]] [[Julius Caesar]] is sold at an auction for [[Pound sterling|£]]2.7 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]3.5 million), becoming the most expensive Roman coin ever auctioned. ;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Aegean Sea earthquake]]
**An [[list of earthquakes in Greece|earthquake]] with a magnitude of 7.0 hits [[Greece]] and [[Turkey]], with an epicentre in the [[Aegean Sea]]. Flooding and destruction of houses is reported in [[Samos]], where two people have died, and [[Izmir]], where 20 people have died and 786 injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-54749509 (BBC News)]
*An unidentified boat carrying refugees sank in [[Mozambique]]. The boat was carrying 74 people. Out of the 74 people on the boat, 54 drowned. [https://infomap.travel/en/snippets/on-october-30-a-tragic-incident-occurred-when-a-boat-transporting-74-refugees-from-the-conflict-af/3000/e4c4ecab35 (InfoMap)]

;Health and environment 
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in Russia]]
*****[[Moscow]] city authorities announce that residents who want to be [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccinated]] against COVID-19 may be able to do so as early as next month if large volumes of doses are supplied by then. Deputy mayor Anastasia Rakova also said the city was creating a large network of specialized vaccination rooms with 2,500 high-risk people already having been vaccinated. [https://www.news18.com/news/india/moscow-authorities-promise-mass-vaccination-against-covid-19-as-russian-cases-soar-3024869.html (News18)]
****[[Russia]] reports 18,283 new cases in the past 24 hours, a new record for the second consecutive day, bringing the nationwide total to 1,599,976, still the fourth-highest in the world. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2020/10/30/russias-daily-coronavirus-cases-cross-18k-in-new-record-a71906 (''The Moscow Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] reports a record increase of 5,627 new cases in the past 24 hours, bringing the cumulative nationwide total to 99,576 confirmed cases. [https://www.vienna.at/rekord-nach-rekord-5-627-corona-neuinfektionen-am-freitag/6792002 (Vienna.at)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
****[[Belgium|Belgian]] [[Prime Minister of Belgium|Prime Minister]] [[Alexander De Croo]] called the situation a "state of sanitary emergency" in the country and announces a second nationwide lockdown from November 1 for at least six weeks, with all non-essential businesses ordered to close. Belgium is the worst affected country in [[Europe]] with more than 1,600 cases per 100,000 people. [https://www.chron.com/news/article/Belgian-virus-cases-continue-their-rise-lockdown-15687757.php (Houston Chronicle)] [https://www.brusselstimes.com/belgium/138485/new-measures-no-ban-on-non-essential-journeys-belgium-coronavirus-measures-press-conference-consultative-committee-social-shopping-autumn-holiday/ (''The Brussels Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Republic|Chamber of Deputies]] votes to extend the [[state of emergency]] in the [[Czech Republic]] until November 20. The present state of emergency is due to expire on November 3. [https://english.radio.cz/pm-babis-asks-lower-house-extend-state-emergency-8698684 (Radio Prague International)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] reports a record 18,681 new cases, pushing the total of confirmed cases near 500,000, according to data from the [[Robert Koch Institute]], making it the third consecutive time the country sets a new record of daily infections. [https://www.rnd.de/gesundheit/corona-neuinfektionen-in-deutschland-rki-meldet-18681-falle-3JL5R7RZAFHLLL2RLVPBJBL2FQ.html (RND)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iceland]]
****[[Iceland]] announces new restrictions, lowering its limit on public gatherings from 20 people to 10 people and suspending sporting activities and stage performances. The new restrictions will take effect tomorrow and last until November 17. [https://grapevine.is/news/2020/10/30/new-pandemic-restrictions-announced/ (Reykjavik Grapevine)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports a record 31,084 new cases in the last 24 hours, pushing the total of confirmed cases to 647,674. [https://www.ilsole24ore.com/art/coronavirus-italia-news-ultime-notizie-aggiornamenti-30-ottobre-ADMBDFz?refresh_ce=1 (''Il Sole 24 ORE'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] reports 21,629 new cases, the largest jump in the number of cases since the start of the [[pandemic]], bringing the total number of cases to 340,834. It also reaches 5,351 COVID-19 deaths, with 202 deaths in the last 24 hours. [https://polandin.com/50573520/covid19-recordbreaking-21629-new-infections-in-poland (Poland In)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Portugal]] reports a record daily increase with 4,656 new cases, bringing the cumulative counts to 137,272 confirmed cases and 2,468 deaths. [https://covid19.min-saude.pt/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/242_DGS_boletim_20201030.pdf (DGS)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] registers its record daily jump in COVID-19 cases for the second day in a row, when the country's [[Ministry of Health (Spain)|Ministry of Health]] reports 25,595 new cases over the past 24 hours. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/europe/spain-hits-new-virus-case-record-2nd-day-in-a-row/2025479 (Anadolu Agency)]

*****[[Mayor of San Francisco|San Francisco Mayor]] [[London Breed]] announces that [[San Francisco|the city]] will pause reopening due to an increase of cases. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/10/30/us/san-francisco-reopening-covid-pause-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
****[[New Jersey]] reports over 2,000 cases, its largest increase in cases during a one-day period since early May. [https://newjersey.news12.com/nj-sees-daily-covid-case-nmbers-reach-s-for-st-time-since-may (News 12)]

*[[LGBT rights in Taiwan]]
**The [[military of Taiwan]] conducts the first [[Mass wedding|mass]] [[same-sex marriage in Taiwan|same-sex marriage]]s since the country became the first Asian nation to legalize same-sex unions in 2019. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-54743789 (BBC)]
*[[Russian interference in the 2020 United States elections]]
**[[Reuters]] reports that [[Fancy Bear]], the Russian hacker group accused of [[Russian interference in the 2016 United States elections|interfering]] in the [[2016 United States presidential election]], had attempted, earlier this year, to hack the email accounts of the [[California]] and [[Indiana]] branches of the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party]], and those of influential [[think tank]]s like the [[Council on Foreign Relations]] and the [[Carnegie Endowment for International Peace]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-election-cyber-russia-exclusive/exclusive-russian-hackers-targeted-california-indiana-democratic-parties-idUSKBN27F1CP?il=0&utm_source=reddit.com (Reuters)] [https://www.theverge.com/2020/10/30/21541822/russian-hackers-elections-democrats-clinton-emails-fancy-bear (''The Verge'')]
